introHtml: Tangle-branded banners, mats, and signs combine the durability of anti-fatigue matting with high-impact signage. Perfect for trade show booths, retail entrances, or safety zones, these products feature Tangle’s proprietary foam core that resists wear in high-traffic areas. Decorate with full-color digital print for logos, warnings, or promotional graphics. Whether you need branded floor mats for an office lobby or weather-resistant banners for outdoor events, Tangle offers a long-lasting solution that keeps your message visible and your team comfortable.
